notes: 32 bars at 125 BPM is 61.44 s (2,949,120 samples at 48 kHz). The container is 61.464 s because of MP3 priming (1105 samples, start time 0.023021 s). ffmpeg and Chrome drop that priming and land on exactly 61.44 s. Both ends sit on a zero crossing, so the wrap step is far smaller than a normal sample step. Playback still sets loopStart/loopEnd to that 61.44 s region. The master is about 0.4 dB quieter than the other loops, so the bed gain is +0.4 dB.
